The '''Arquata Station Amendments''' were a series of proposals that amended the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Convention of Civilized Systems/Legends|Convention of Civilized Systems]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The amendments extended the Convention's coverage of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to races that lived in multiple [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] but appeared incapable of [[Realspace/Legends|interstellar]] travel.
